camel_example: aliyun ehpc DescribeImagePrice --region cn-hangzhou --PriceUnit Day --SkuCode package --Amount 2 --ImageId 'm-bp198jigq7l1ga11****' --Period 1
description_en: Queries the prices of Alibaba Cloud Marketplace images supported by Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC)
description_zh: 调用DescribeImagePrice查询E-HPC支持的镜像市场的镜像价格
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc describe-image-price --image-id 'm-bp198jigq7l1ga11****' --price-unit Day --sku-code package --period 1 --amount 2 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImagePrice

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Day: day.
Month: month.
Year: year.

Default value: Day
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长的单位。取值范围：

Day：日
Month：月
Year：年

默认值：Day
parameters.name: price_unit

parameters.help_en: The commodity specification code. Currently, only package (subscription) is supported
parameters.help_zh: 商品规格码。当前仅支持：package（预付费）
parameters.name: sku_code

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

When PriceUnit is set to Day: 1 to 30.
When PriceUnit is set to Month: 1 to 9.
When PriceUnit is set to Year: 1 to 3.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长。取值范围：
当参数PriceUnit取值为Day时：1~30
当参数PriceUnit取值为Month时：1~9
当参数PriceUnit取值为Year时：1~3


默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The purchase quantity. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
购买数量。取值范围：1~1000

默认值：1
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en: The order type. Only commodity purchase is supported. Valid value: INSTANCE-BUY
parameters.help_zh: 订单类型，仅支持设置为商品购买。取值：INSTANCE-BUY
parameters.name: order_type
